raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 9, Reason for Mistake: Despite sources confirming that Kitiyakara Voralaksana is the paternal grandfather (father of Nakkhatra Mangala and noted as Sirikit’s paternal grandfather), the Planner misinferred and wrongly named Prince Bhanurangsi Savangwongse, even misattributing the “1st Prince of Chanthaburi” title, leading to an incorrect final answer.
